item.title: Atmore police serve search warrant in ongoing investigation of Jan. 19 shooting of two
item.description: Atmore police execute Bragg Street search warrant tied to Jan. 19 shooting that injured two near Ashley Street and Carver Avenue; investigation continues.

item.title: Melvin H. Ferrell

item.description: Atmore man Nathaniel Crenshaw charged with attempted murder after Jan. 19 shooting that injured two; police say the fast-moving investigation may lead to more arrests.

item.title: Gertrude Smith
item.description: Gertrude Smith, 97, of Atmore, passed away Mon., January 26, 2026 in Foley. She was born to Ruby and Ollie Moye on December 25, 1928. She was a graduate of Escambia County in Atmore. She was a faithful member of First Baptist Church in Atmore, where she cherished her church family and friendships. item.title: APD to recognize Law Enforcement Explorer program members in ceremony January 29 at city hall
item.description: The Atmore Police Department will recognize members of its inaugural Law Enforcement Explorer Program on Thurs., January 29, at 5 p.m. at city hall. The eight-week program was open to boys and girls ages 14–18, and was free of charge. Participants were required be in good standing with school administrators. item.title: Dog rescued, no injuries reported in Ashley Street house fire in Atmore
item.description: Dog rescued, no injuries after fire heavily damages under-construction Ashley Street home in Atmore; cause remains undetermined, fire officials say.

item.title: Atmore police make additional arrest in Jan. 19 shooting, charge suspect with attempted murder
item.description: Atmore police arrest Tobijah Keimond Crenshaw in Jan. 19 shooting, charge him with attempted murder; earlier, Nathaniel Crenshaw surrendered as case remains active.
